items.label: 1.91'' HD Touch Screen & 200+ DIY Watch Faces
items.value: P114 smart watch is equipped with a 1.91" HD full touch color highest resolution ultra clear TFT screen, delivering highly responsive touch. With the companion GloryFit app, you can download more than 200 free personalised watch faces and set it as your desktop.

items.label: 24-Hour Health Monitoring and 7 Day Battery Life
items.value: The fitness tracker is equipped with high-performance optical sensors that will record your all day activities. Fitness watch provides health monitoring features such as Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen(Sp02), and Sleep Monitoring(Deep/light sleep). The pedometer smart watches equipped with the latest chip and 300 mAh battery, once fully charged,this smartwatch could last 7 days in using,20 days for power saving mode and 30 days on standby mode.

items.label: 120+ Sports Modes & IP68 Waterproof
items.value: The activity tracker supports over 120 sports modes, including Running, Walking, Hiking, Basketball, Cycling, Fitness, Football, Yoga & More. During your exercise, it will record your data like heart rate, steps, calories burned, distance in real time. Sport watch is IP68 waterproof rating, ensuring worry-free use even while washing hands, face, or engaging in sweaty activities. However, it is not recommended for use in hot water or seawater.

items.label: Make/Answer Calls & Read Message
items.value: The smart watches with its built-in HD speakers and Bluetooth connectivity allow you to make and receive calls and ringtone reminders for incoming calls. It also supports information reminders (Facebook,Instagram,etc.), stores contacts and views call history. Enable message receiving privileges for your smart watch and notifications are displayed on your watch. So you won't miss any important calls or messages even if you put your phone in your pocket.

items.label: Multifunctional and Warm Tips
items.value: The smart watch is compatible with iOS 10.0 and Android 9.0 and above devices, it has multiple functions such as timer, alarm clock, sedentary reminder, music control, weather forecast, photo control, calculator, etc. Please wear your P114 Smart Watch correctly, the strap should be fastened neither too tightly nor too loosely, leaving room for your skin to breathe. This will not only keep you comfortable, but also allow the sensors to work properly.
